hero.headline2: Prove it. Unlock the next step.
hero.subtext: The AI Skill-to-Opportunity engine bridging academic and vocational talent across Tamil Nadu. Identify precise skill gaps, practice adaptively, prove competence through verifiable code and craft inspections, and match verified opportunities.
hero.whatDoYouWant: What do you want to become?
hero.trustLine: No login needed · No personal data · Works completely offline or with live AI

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From initial aspirations to verified employment through real, evidence-backed milestones.
howItWorks.step1Summary: Captures your daily time commitment (30-90 mins), local district preference, and baseline skills without tedious logins.
howItWorks.step2Summary: Parses live employer job descriptions with Claude AI to extract exact rubric criteria and diagnostic skill deltas.
howItWorks.step3Summary: Dynamically reorders modules and generates micro-challenges focused strictly on bridging detected skill gaps.
howItWorks.step4Summary: Submit reproducible code, photo inspections of physical craft, and bilingual voice vivas graded against strict rubrics.
howItWorks.step5Summary: Direct matching with verified district jobs, MSME boutique contracts, and Govt NATS apprenticeships backed by your QR Passport.

cycle.title: The Proof-to-Progress Cycle
cycle.subtitle: Click any stage of the cycle to see how learning continuously verifies ability and adapts to employer expectations.

details.identifyDesc: Benchmark your starting point. Unassessed skills stay strictly neutral ("Not assessed"). Real job requirements are extracted automatically.
details.learnDesc: Micro-modules adapted to your daily time. Practice hands-on with real craft and code swatches.
details.proveDesc: Upload code repositories, take photo reviews with measuring tape/coins, and explain concepts in natural voice viva.
details.adaptDesc: The AI re-indexes your pathway based on rubric feedback and upgrades your Skill Passport for direct workplace hiring.

beyondMcq.title: Built for Real-World Competence
beyondMcq.subtitle: Multiple-choice tests don't prove you can build accessible websites or tailor bridal garments. SkillBridge evaluates genuine ability.

jdGap.title: JD Gap Analysis
jdGap.desc: Compares your actual verified portfolio against real job descriptions using strict AI parsing—not a generic course syllabus.

photoTrade.title: Photo Evidence for Trades
photoTrade.desc: Computer vision and rubric models inspect stitch density (10 SPI), seam margins, and wire conduits from your phone camera.

aiViva.title: AI Viva & Voice Defense
aiViva.desc: Answer conversational questions in natural language. Defend your code choices or craft decisions without written exam stress.

voiceTamil.title: Bilingual Voice Support
voiceTamil.desc: Rural and local learners explain technical ideas freely in their mother tongue. Language is never a barrier.

skillPassport.title: Skill Passport with QR
skillPassport.desc: Cryptographically verifiable digital credential with live proof links and rubrics that employers can inspect in one scan.

mentorSeal.title: Mentor Verification Seal
mentorSeal.desc: Transparent multi-tier trust: AI-reviewed, Mentor-verified, and Pending mentor review. Transparent and honest.
